title: Odd Cycles and Odd-Population Solvability in Random Stable Roommates
description: Working paper: the invariant odd-cycle population has a Rayleigh times arcsine limit and mean asymptotic to the square root of pi n over eight, for either parity. For odd populations, solvability has a stretched-exponential asymptotic. Includes exact finite checks and internal mathematical reviews. AI-assisted, not externally peer reviewed.
